attempts.exact_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: one source-faithful static creature master for human approval; no animation
Primary request: redraw the native Heroes of Might and Magic III BASE VAMPIRE, CVAMP, as a finely modeled full-body transparent game-art cutout. Follow the supplied original pixels closely rather than redesigning the creature.
Input images: Image 1 is native-idle-6x.png and is the exact identity, proportion, silhouette, facing and idle-pose authority. Image 2 is native-g07-guide.png, supporting head and costume evidence only. Image 3 is native-g12-guide.png, supporting hands, clothing and anatomy only, NOT the requested attack pose. Image 4 is the approved Pikeman rendering master, used ONLY for fine modeled-volume rendering, clean edges and material finish; take no human soldier anatomy, armor, weapon, costume or colors from it.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent background, empty negative space. One figure only, all of its head, hands, claws and feet visible with generous clear margins. No floor, shadow, backdrop color or checkerboard pixels.
Subject: the lean pale bald pointed-eared claw-handed base Vampire visible in Image 1. Preserve its tall narrow adult anatomy and elongated angular pallid face and chin, smooth bald skull, hooked profile, recessed reddish eyes, and pointed ears. Preserve the restrained source palette: dark charcoal and worn brown-gray fitted ragged tunic, short close shoulder cloth, dull gray front and uneven split thigh-length hem, close brownish leggings, simple low black footwear, pale exposed wrists and hands with small dark-red claw tips. Clothing stays modest and close to the body, with the subtle dark reddish chest fastenings visible in the source. No ornate hardware or invented costume.
Pose and camera: replicate Image 1's native right-facing three-quarter idle exactly. Upright long-legged stance with modestly bent knees and two separated planted feet, head pitched slightly forward from the hunched shoulders. Both elbows bent near the ribs; both hands held loosely in front of the belly, wrists bent down and long fingers hanging in small claw curves. The near hand is lower and crosses the waist; the far hand sits slightly higher and farther to screen right. Keep the source's compact arm silhouette, limb lengths and narrow shoulder-to-hip proportions. Overall visible silhouette width approximately 0.46 times its height. Do not turn it into a crouching, lunging or reaching attack pose.
Style/medium: match the Pikeman's finely shaded, carefully modeled painted game-art volume and restrained surface detail. Crisp readable silhouette, subtle worn cloth/leather grain, gently sculpted pale skin and small controlled highlights. Render new detailed artwork; do not upscale, mosaic or trace enlarged block pixels.
Constraints: one static master; no captions, labels, watermark, panel layout or extra props. No noble Dracula red cape, flowing cloak, red lining, aristocratic suit, crown, weapon, armor plates, hood, hair, beard, wings, bat, smoke, transformation effect, glow, magic or ground shadow. Preserve the original base creature and pose; avoid cartoon blocks, chibi proportions, inflated muscles and exaggerated monster claws.
